Mũ, áo, đồ đeo lưng, bùa và cánh giờ do: Hats, robes, back gear, charms and wings are now sewn by the Tailor from Spirit Wood, Fish Scale and Flint. The hats and robes I forged before were moved to your outfit stash. None were lost.
Kéo ở nửa trái màn hình để đi, hoặc chạm: Drag on the left half of the screen to walk, or tap a villager and your kid runs over. The row of faces along the top is a shortcut. A gold exclamation mark means someone has news.
Cảm ứng: đặt ngón ở nửa trái màn hình rồ: Touch: put a finger on the left half of the screen and drag to move. Round buttons on the right: hold Attack to keep striking, Dodge to roll away, Special for a strong move (costs mana); the top button is Palm.
Nút Chưởng bắn một luồng chưởng linh khí: The Palm button fires a blast of spirit energy (costs {0} mana), auto-aimed at the nearest monster in eight directions. Its element follows the Palm tree in use. Each kid has a twist: Cu Ti knocks back hard, Cu Tèo flies far and fast, Cái Bống heals a little on hit, Cu Lì is short-range but big. Palms give no Spirit to weapons (Spirit comes only from weapons) and do not react with weapon elements.
Hỏa chưởng: cầu lửa nổ lan, vệt cháy, gi: Fire Palm: exploding fireball, burn trail, hold the button to charge. Poison Palm: poison cloud, spreading poison, armor corrosion, splits in 3. Ice Palm: ice bolt piercing many monsters, slow, freeze, shatter. Each level gives 1 Palm point (separate from skill points). One tree at a time; in the village, swap trees for free at the Scholar (Palm tree tab) or in the Inventory, and all spent points are refunded.
Mọi đòn tự quay về quái gần nhất trong t: Every attack turns to the nearest monster in range, in all eight directions (up, down, diagonal). With no monster near, you attack where the stick points, or the way you last moved.
Chạm ô vũ khí ở góc trên bên phải để đổi: Tap the weapon slot at the top right to switch to the next weapon (cycles all 4). Tap the Potion slot to heal. Tap Pause to take a break.
Lại gần rương, suối hay thương nhân rồi: Go up to a chest, spring or merchant and press Attack. Clear the monsters and doors open: take a door with an arrow to the next room. Tap the minimap to see the stage.
Mũi tên hoặc WASD để đi, J đánh (ở làng:: Arrows or WASD to move, J attack (in the village: talk), K dodge, L special, I Palm (hold to charge), Q swap weapon, E drink potion, M map, Esc pause or close a panel.
Sao 1: qua ải. Sao 2: không dùng bình má: Star 1: clear the stage. Star 2: use no potion. Star 3: finish off the boss with the element that counters it.
Vùng đỏ trên sàn là chỗ đòn sắp rơi xuốn: A red floor zone is where a hit will land. It fills, then bursts: step out or roll through. Monsters attack in all directions, diagonals too. A red ring on empty ground: a monster is about to spawn.
Xông tới, bầy nhỏ, bắn xa (gọi thêm bầy): Chargers, small packs, shooters (call more packs), nimble (dive, then pop up behind you), armored (front shield, heal allies: get behind or break the armor), kamikazes (rush in and explode), bombers (bombs have a countdown ring), spiked (hit them with spikes up and you get hit back). Blasts freeze in the Sea Cave, leave poison pools in the Old Forest, burn trails in the Ancient Castle.
Tinh anh có chiêu riêng và một dấu hiệu: Elites have their own move and a sign overhead: lightning is fast, shield is armored, bomb explodes on death, blood drop is lifesteal. Mini-bosses have two moves of their own. Region bosses have three phases, changing at 2/3 and 1/3 HP; later phases add moves and speed. After a big move the boss is stunned for a moment: that is the time to hit hardest.
Chậu than, nấm độc và tinh thể băng phát: Braziers, poison mushrooms and ice crystals explode when hit and affect nearby monsters. Use them to apply elements while your weapon is still Plain.
Thường (sát thương x1, tiến hóa tới Thàn: Common (damage x1, evolves to Formed), Blue (x1.15, 1 affix), Purple (x1.3, 2 affixes), Gold (x1.5 and up, 2 affixes and 1 unique power affix). Blue and above can evolve to Awakened.
Rương và quái tinh anh rơi vũ khí bậc ng: Chests and elites drop weapons of a random tier, Purple at most; later regions roll higher tiers more often. A region boss always drops a Gold weapon the first time it falls. The Blacksmith upgrades tier one step at a time without losing evolution; the step to Gold needs boss shards.

Spirit (marks) comes from: beating elites ({0}), mini-bosses ({1}), region bosses ({2}); normal monsters have a {3}% chance to drop the region's Spirit orb ({4}), walk close to pick it up; and killing a monster under an element effect (+1). The element is the one on the monster, or the region's if none. Sprout: a chance to burn, poison or slow, but no element rule yet. Formed: unlocks trait 1, what it leaves on the field (burn trail, poison pool, ice spikes). Awakened: unlocks trait 2, chain reactions (spreading blast, spreading poison, shatter).
